The Clear Choice for a Confident Smile

Invisalign is a modern, discreet orthodontic solution that uses clear, removable aligners to gently and comfortably straighten your teeth. Invisalign offers a virtually invisible way to achieve the smile you’ve always wanted — without compromising your confidence or lifestyle.

Why Orthodontics?

Orthodontic treatment isn’t just about aesthetics — it’s about creating a healthy bite, boosting your self-confidence, and protecting your long-term oral health. Whether you’re addressing gaps, crowding, or bite issues, orthodontics ensures your smile looks great and functions perfectly.

Braces & Invisalign

We offer both traditional metal braces and Invisalign clear aligners to effectively straighten teeth. Each treatment plan is fully customized to meet your smile goals with maximum comfort and precision.

 Clear Aligners

Nearly invisible and removable, clear aligners are ideal for those seeking a discreet, flexible solution to correct alignment without metal brackets or wires.

Pediatric Orthodontics

Early orthodontic care helps guide proper jaw and tooth development, preventing future dental issues. We provide gentle, effective treatments tailored for children.

Cosmetic Smile Alignment

For adults with mild crowding or spacing, our aesthetic alignment treatments deliver a confident, beautiful smile — often without the need for full braces.

Why Choose Invisalign?

Invisalign has completely transformed orthodontic care, offering a smarter, more comfortable alternative to braces. Here’s why it’s the preferred choice for teens and adults:

Nearly Invisible

Clear aligners blend seamlessly with your natural teeth. Most people won’t even know you’re wearing them.

Removable & Flexible

Eat, brush, and floss freely — Invisalign fits perfectly into your lifestyle.

Comfortable Fit

Crafted from smooth SmartTrack® material, Invisalign aligners are custom-designed to fit snugly without irritation.

Fewer Clinic Visits

Enjoy fewer adjustments and check-ups compared to traditional braces.

Predictable Results

Advanced 3D imaging allows you to see your treatment plan and expected outcome from the start.

Improved Oral Hygiene

Since aligners are removable, maintaining your oral health is easier, reducing plaque buildup and gum issues.

Why Choose Krest Dental for Invisalign?

Experience world-class Invisalign care at Krest Dental, led by UCSF-trained Dr. Suneeta Veeramachaneni. Our blend of advanced technology, personalized treatment, and unmatched expertise makes us the preferred choice in Visakhapatnam.

World-Class Technology

Digital scanners, 3D imaging, and modern orthodontic tools ensure precise, comfortable treatment.

Expert-Led Care

Over 23 years of global experience and leadership in cosmetic and orthodontic dentistry.

Personalized Treatment Plans

Every Invisalign journey is custom-tailored to your smile goals and lifestyle.

Trusted by Thousands

Backed by countless happy patients and consistently outstanding results.
